lockAndRevalidate.input: CustomerServiceLevelFactRevalidationQuery with a separate ExpectedCustomerServiceLevelFact copied from the complete previously inspected fact
lockAndRevalidate.transaction: PROPAGATION_REQUIRED; joins the CUT write transaction and locks the CUS customer timeline
lockAndRevalidate.result: same AVAILABLE/NOT_CONFIGURED fact when exact, otherwise STALE carrying the complete current fact

trustedTenant: query.tenantId must equal TenantContextHolder.getRequiredTenantId before Owner access; no tenant switching

factUnion.AVAILABLE: positive serviceLevelRevisionId, normalized nonblank serviceLevelCode max64, nonnull effectiveFrom and optional exclusive effectiveTo strictly after effectiveFrom; Provider selects the fact at its trusted server Clock
factUnion.NOT_CONFIGURED: serviceLevelRevisionId/serviceLevelCode/effectiveFrom/effectiveTo are all null; factVersion remains a comparable customer service-level timeline watermark and no placeholder is allowed
factUnion.factVersion: version of the revision selected at the trusted server Clock; when NOT_CONFIGURED use the greatest revision version whose interval has already started, or zero when none has started; status and the complete nullable union remain part of equality

revalidation.inputOwnership: malformed caller ExpectedCustomerServiceLevelFact is INVALID_REQUEST; malformed CUS current fact/result is OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED
revalidation.exactComparison: status, tenantId, customerId, revisionId, code, factVersion and effective interval
revalidation.match: return AVAILABLE or NOT_CONFIGURED with the locked current fact
revalidation.mismatch: return STALE with the locked complete current fact; no business write

consumerMapping.AVAILABLE: CUT may freeze the fact and may submit P2 when all other guards pass
consumerMapping.NOT_CONFIGURED: CUT may create and save P2 draft but returns CUSTOMER_SERVICE_LEVEL_NOT_CONFIGURED when submitting
consumerMapping.OWNER_DATA_CORRUPTED: internal failure; never masquerade as NOT_CONFIGURED or STALE

controlledSimulation.allowed: after this contract passes, F-CUT-002 unit and integration test assembly may provide deterministic AVAILABLE, NOT_CONFIGURED and changed-current-fact responses
controlledSimulation.forbidden: no double in src/main or production Bean assembly; no simulated level is CUS-02 completion, real browser evidence or Implementation Done
